description: Benign fixture for Azure Storage where sensitive blob accounts use Entra authorization and a legacy Azure Files Shared Key exception is bounded, monitored, rotated, and migrating.

storage_accounts.name: prodhealthrecords
storage_accounts.evidence_source: terraform shared_access_key_enabled=false plus Azure CLI allowSharedKeyAccess=false export

sas_usage.revocation: disable managed identity or revoke Entra role assignment

exception.migration_target: Microsoft Entra Kerberos for Azure Files

listkeys_principals.role: Storage Account Key Operator Service Role

expected_gate_results.evidence: Sensitive storage inventory records data sensitivity, services, owners, and authorization mode.
Shared Key is disabled for ePHI blobs and excepted only for bounded legacy Files use.
listkeys is limited to an approved break-glass group with PIM and account-only scope.
SAS inventory records user delegation type, scope, permissions, expiry, IP, protocol, and issuer.
Legacy account has SAS expiration policy with Block action and seven-day maximum.
Stored access policy, 30-day key rotation, and emergency revocation test are documented.
Storage diagnostics route key/SAS signals and read/write/delete events to SOC Log Analytics.
No missing Shared Key, SAS, listkeys, or diagnostic evidence is counted as passing.
